compound: ajñāna (ignorance) + indhana (fuel) + dāhaka (burner); nominative singular masculine predicate

items.question: What capacity belongs to one endowed with five rays regarding ignorance?
premises: The subject is endowed with five rays.
The subject is characterized as a burner of ignorance-fuel.
The quality of burning ignorance-fuel coexists with being endowed with five rays.
items.inference: One endowed with five rays possesses the power to burn ignorance as fuel.
uncertainties: The specific identity or symbolism of the five rays is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Even when endowed with five rays, he is a burner of the fuel of ignorance.
